analysis.rationale: Deterministic 2-step pipeline confirmed by exact reproduction: brightness_brighten_shfit_HSV:3 then compression_jpeg:2 yields PSNR=inf and CI 10/10 on pair0 as well as all 4 remaining pairs (degraded_1..4). Signal chain: mean_shift=+60.5/255 with chroma_ratio=1.425 -> HSV V-shift (multiplicative, scales chroma) not RGB shift; severity scan sev5/4/3/2 -> 18.30/22.79/30.32/21.43 dB picks sev3. block_boundary=1.7284 (0% FP) -> JPEG; on top of global sev4/3/2 -> 28.73/30.44/inf dB picks sev2 (q=18). Peeled residual std=0.0, noise sigma 0.37/0.74 < 2 -> NO_NOISE; spectral_slope_ratio=1.0026 -> no blur (gm_ratio=0.701 drop fully explained by brightness+JPEG).
